name: Wisconsin Metal Fab LLC
old_description: With the completion of our fifth facilities expansion in 2021, we’re perfectly situated to grow along with your contract manufacturing needs. Our 106,000 square foot facility is home to a full-service, start-to-finish custom fabrication shop that can create your prototype or production-quantity projects, on-time, and defect-free.
about:
Wisconsin Metal Fab LLC operates from Chippewa Falls, Wisconsin. The company completed its fifth facility expansion in 2021, bringing its manufacturing space to 106,000 square feet (a capabilities page also references 77,000 square feet). Ownership structure and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

The shop functions as a contract manufacturer and metal fabricator, producing custom components in carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. Processes include CNC machining, precision laser and plasma cutting, turret punching, forming, robotic and manual welding, sawing, shearing, and project development, with in-house prefinishing, finishing, assembly, and transportation. The facility houses horizontal and vertical machining centers, horizontal mills, precision laser cutters, robotic welders, and CNC plasma cutters, and maintains a large on-hand inventory of sheet, plate, tube, and bar stock to support prototype through production runs.

Regular customers span oil production companies, large truck component manufacturers, railway maintenance operations, and water treatment facilities. A testimonial from Superior Diesel Inc. cites confidence in delivery, quality, and design support for new applications.

Wisconsin Metal Fab positions itself as a one-stop solution, emphasizing start-to-finish capability, CNC-controlled repeatability, and quick turnaround—most projects in two weeks or less—backed by ISO 9001 certification.
